_comment: Phase E s6 - milestone rewards, granted the moment the player reaches each level. Sum of effects is added on top of level/talent/gear stats and is stored in the save (GameState.milestones_claimed).

milestones.title: Wayfarer
milestones.text: The road knows your name now.

milestones.title: Ember-Touched
milestones.text: Ash still clings to your cloak.

milestones.title: Shield of Millhaven
milestones.text: Oakstead's gate opens before you ask.

milestones.title: Barrens-Rider
milestones.text: You cross the slag without a guide.

milestones.title: Choir-Breaker
milestones.text: Wards you once feared now break at your word.

milestones.title: Keeper of the Flame
milestones.text: Soldiers of Cinderhold salute you first.

milestones.title: Vessel-Warden
milestones.text: You have learned what the Choir whispers.

milestones.title: Skyreach
milestones.text: Nothing above the clouds bars your way.
